fit_linear_references: fit linear element references for target properties using a dataset and least squares regression
create_element_references: create a LinearReferences module from a .pt or .npz file containing element reference values
load_references_from_config: load element references from a configuration dictionary using either fitting or file loading
apply_refs_dereference: apply or remove linear element references from target tensors using LinearReferences dereference and forward methods
compute_element_references: compute element-wise reference values for a batch using ElementReferences compute_references static method
